analyst.summary: Anthem Biosciences: integrated CRDMO + specialty-ingredients CDMO, FY26 revenue/PAT +18%/+31% with a record Q4 (+26% revenue), but a mid-year guidance cut (Q3 destocking, -15% YoY revenue) shows CDMO order lumpiness is real. Valuation is rich (~72x trailing P/E) and reverse-DCF implies roughly a decade of ~26-27% PAT growth priced in. No quant score yet -- default Hold, no red flags found that would warrant a Sell override.
